title: Peel With Ease
text: Peel With Ease. The Greatest peeler of all time. Fits perfectly in your hands.  Peels with extreme Ease. No more pain from peeling.

product_metadata.title: Cooking Light Ceramic Peeler Set with Ultra Sharp and Durable Blades, Ergonomic Handles Black and Red Kitchen Tools, 2 Piece, Black/Red
features: Set includes: 2 ceramic blade peelers with nonslip handles
Quality construction: The sturdy construction of these peelers will allow you to peel through tough veggies, starches and fruits easily.

Multifunctional peelers: besides peeling veggies and starches, these straight peelers can also be used to shave chocolate to decorate a cake, zest citrus fruits, make beautiful vegetable ribbons for a Salad, shave cheese slices or even shave butter for serving.

Premium performance Sharp blades: The ceramic blades on these peelers are super sharp, allowing you to peel through tough skins with minimal effort. The ceramic blades stay sharp after multiple uses, allowing you to have perfectly peeled ingredients every time.
Easy to use: the ergonomic handle allows you to get a firm, comfortable grip on these peelers while using them.
Easy to clean & store: simply wash with Warm water and soap- it’s that easy!
